XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Battery warning light on, low battery warning
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 58673 | ELECTRONICS | CHARGING | DISCHARGING | WARNING | ABS | VEHICLE | FAULT | ELECTRICAL | AIRBAG | STOP | SERVICE | WARNING LIGHTS | VOLTAGE | POWER SUPPLY | CURRENT |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured from 01/01/18 to 31/05/21

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: 12V battery

  • Fault: Battery warning light comes on, various warnings may appear such as "Battery low", "Check Airbag, ABS, vehicle", "Electronic fault", ABS, Stop, Service and Airbag warning lights may come on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty 12V battery terminal

• Action: Check the 12V battery terminals and replace the faulty terminal

  • Procedure: Ensure that the vehicle's 12V battery is fully charged and working, then check the condition of the 12V battery terminals.
    Replace the faulty terminal, tightening the terminal bracket retaining nut to 8 Nm.

  • Notes: - -
